Name: Kove's Eastern and Western Style Gold Clock
Author: SHAMP233
Description:
There are 3 kind of image you can choose .

One is western-like (European) and the others are Eastern-like (Seres) .

If you want to use the western one , you should open the config.json and name the gold clock "Belltower" , then change the value of "pointer" into 1 .

Ifyou want to have a eastern style gold clock , their names are "Pavilion" and "Drumtower" , and remember to number the "pointer" into 2 .
